scope: Physical R131 multi-owner, monitor and bounded slow-reader completion supplement

decision.overall_note: Shared-path registration p95 guards separately failed; this supplement does not override them

guard.flag: six R131/R124 paired deltas positive and median > 5%

slow.interpretation: Bounded drop is the exact C contract at cap; surviving frame counts need not be equal. All surviving frames had valid payload, target, FIFO and sequence, followed by full recovery. Kernel packing is only a plausible explanation for the count difference, not measured causation.

limits: Regression gate compares R131 with R124. C monitor performance remains worse and is disclosed separately.
Per-operation latency includes exact libubus send, per-owner polling and listener/monitor validation; it is not daemon-only latency.
The latency array is not prefaulted; all subjects use the same helper.
Monitor ordering is checked within each stream, not wall-clock ordering across two sockets.
AF_UNIX ignores SO_RCVBUF; the actual stress is a fixed flood with a paused reader, independently confirmed by observed drop.
Slow metrics time sender acknowledgements before drain; no normal-delivery performance gate uses them.
Immediate memory snapshots do not establish allocator or kernel socket peaks or settled residency.
No rerun, window exclusion, threshold change, runtime change or deployment was performed.
